logline: 아내가 준 은화를 만지작거리며 방에만 있던 남자가, 어느 날 층계를 올라 도시의 지붕 위에 선다.
destination: 백화점 옥상 — 그가 처음으로 도시를 내려다보는 자리
protagonist: 아내에게 얹혀 사는 무기력한 젊은 지식인
setting: 1930년대 경성의 셋방 골목과 백화점, 종일 어두운 아랫방
anchor: a gaunt young man in a rumpled white shirt and worn trousers, unkempt hair, 1930s Gyeongseong back room
palette: sepia gloom indoors, cold paper-window light, hazy city grey outside

beats.beat: 젊은 남자가 어두운 아랫방에서 눈을 뜬다.
beats.visual: a young man lying awake on a floor mat in a dim windowless back room, paper door faintly lit
beats.motion: the paper door glows and dims, his hand shifts, dust hangs in the air

beats.visual: a lit paper partition seen from a dark room, two silhouettes moving behind it
beats.motion: silhouettes shift behind the paper, lamplight wavers, the partition rattles

beats.visual: a thin hand turning small silver coins over on a floor mat in weak light
beats.motion: coins turn between fingers and clink, light slides over them

beats.beat: 밤이 되자 그는 골목으로 걸어 나간다.
beats.visual: a gaunt young man walking a narrow alley of tin roofs at night, single bare bulb overhead
beats.motion: the bulb swings, his shadow stretches and shrinks, dust lifts

beats.beat: 비를 맞고 돌아와 그는 약을 삼킨다.
beats.visual: a soaked young man sitting on a floor mat holding a small paper packet, water pooling around him
beats.motion: water drips from his hair, the packet unfolds, his shoulders shake

beats.beat: 그는 낮이고 밤이고 잠에서 깨지 못한다.
beats.visual: a young man asleep face down on a floor mat, sunlight and lamplight alternating on the wall
beats.motion: light on the wall brightens then dims, his breathing lifts his back

beats.beat: 어느 날 그는 층계를 올라 옥상에 선다.
beats.visual: a young man standing at a department store rooftop parapet above a hazy city, wind in his shirt
beats.motion: his shirt snaps in the wind, city haze drifts, his hands grip the parapet

beats.visual: a young man on a rooftop with both arms half raised against a wide pale sky, city small below
beats.motion: his arms rise, wind pushes his sleeves back, clouds race past behind him

withheld: 그가 날개를 펴 보고 싶다고 외치며 끝나는 마지막 대목
